svg.text: Threads affiliate agent: content and experiment loop
One coordinating agent on the ChatGPT API. Records and approvals live in Excel, drafts in Google Docs and sources in Google Drive. Publishing stays manual.
Decides the next stage or tool;
keeps task state and the log
e.g. a discount with no expiry date
Dashed arrows = loops back for rework. Icons are generic, not product logos.
